entries.tasks: Day 1 — Room prep & window frame sanding
entries.notes:
Arrived 9 AM, started 9:30 AM. Pushed all furniture to center of room and covered with plastic wrap and tape. Cleaned windows. Sanded bottom and top window frames in upper room. Removed carpet in corners. Sanded door frames and general wood trim around room. General prep work for painting. Done by 6 PM.

Breaks: 2× smoke (30 min each) + lunch (45 min) = 1h 45min excluded.

💰 7.25 hrs × $50 = $362.50
